cohort: 812 pregnant women were recruited in their first trimester.
finding: Women with the highest dietary glycemic load (GL) were 43% more likely to develop GDM, while no significant association was found between dietary glycemic index (GI) and GDM risk.
followup_time: from first trimester until 24-28 weeks of gestation
gest_age: recruitment in first trimester, GDM diagnosis at 24-28 weeks of gestation
